capabilities: Upload the current note to Feishu Docs
Upload local images and convert their links to Feishu format
Set document visibility, copy and download permissions
Show upload history and monthly API call counts
Encrypt Feishu credentials locally with AES-GCM
disambiguation: Not a two-way vault sync tool; it uploads individual notes to Feishu Docs on demand.
extras: Setup requires creating a Feishu application and a target folder (estimated 5–10 minutes); the detailed configuration guide is hosted externally. Batch upload is not supported because of Feishu storage and API quotas.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn a note into a shareable cloud document, so sharing a note means copying or exporting it by hand.

relations.evidence: Data flows exclusively between your device and Feishu—never passes through any third-party server.

requires.name: Feishu application credentials (App ID and App Secret)

summary: Uploads the current note to Feishu Docs as a shareable document, handling local images, permissions and upload history.
